note.es: Alberta Agriculture and Irrigation, Alberta Farm Input Prices (Open Government Licence - Alberta): Propano para uso agricola a granel; precio por 100 litros dividido entre 100. Serie mensual en dolares canadienses. Cambio de unidad hecho por Dehesa Index con aritmetica exacta, sin estimar nada.
note.en: Alberta Agriculture and Irrigation, Alberta Farm Input Prices (Open Government Licence - Alberta): Farm propane, bulk; price per 100 litres divided by 100. Monthly series in Canadian dollars. Unit conversion done by Dehesa Index with exact arithmetic; nothing is estimated.
note.fr: Alberta Agriculture and Irrigation, Alberta Farm Input Prices (Open Government Licence - Alberta): Propane à usage agricole en vrac ; prix par 100 litres divisé par 100. Série mensuelle en dollars canadiens. Changement d'unité effectué par Dehesa Index en arithmétique exacte, sans rien estimer.
note.it: Alberta Agriculture and Irrigation, Alberta Farm Input Prices (Open Government Licence - Alberta): Propano a uso agricolo sfuso; prezzo per 100 litri diviso per 100. Serie mensile in dollari canadesi. Cambio di unità eseguito da Dehesa Index con aritmetica esatta, senza stimare nulla.
